ValidationRule.description: Prevents changing the OO for SD (via Restrict_Opp_Owner_Change_All_Stage custom permission, granted through their Permission Set Groups). Also prevents the owner from reassigning ownership on their own record. Blocks SS OO Change if stage is beyond 4
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(OwnerId), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator",
OR( AND( PRIORVALUE(OwnerId) = $User.Id, NOT( AND( $Permission.Restrict_Opp_Owner_Change_till_stage_4, OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "1-Suspect"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "2-Prospect"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "3-Quote"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "4-Negotiate") ) ) ) ), $Permission.Restrict_Opp_Owner_Change_All_Stages, AND( $Permission.Restrict_Opp_Owner_Change_till_stage_4, NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "1-Suspect")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "2-Prospect")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "3-Quote")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "4-Negotiate")) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to change the Opportunity Owner. Please contact your Revenue Operation Team or Salesforce Administrator if this needs to be updated
